longyuan_sword:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Minecraft mod 64×64 inventory weapon sprite, one standalone item.
Primary request: 龙渊剑 (Longyuan Sword), an unmistakable ancient Chinese dragon-abyss sword.
Subject: single straight double-edged sword, diagonal from lower-left dark teal wrapped grip to upper-right sharp tip. Broad cool silver-blue blade with a thin turquoise jade-like central groove; restrained dark-blue shadow plane. A compact symmetric bronze dragon-whisker crossguard and bronze pommel make it clearly Chinese and distinct. The blade must remain the dominant form, not a dragon creature.
Style/medium: polished hand-placed Minecraft pixel art, square hard-edged pixel clusters, readable at native 64×64, controlled 32–48 color palette, crisp 1–3 pixel highlights, no smooth gradients or airbrushing.
Composition: sprite nearly fills the square with about 2 pixels breathing room at extremities, complete sword visible, single object only.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent RGBA background, no floor, no inventory frame.
Constraints: obvious sword silhouette and hilt separation even at thumbnail scale; no text, watermark, labels, border, glow halo, extra objects or ornate photorealistic rendering.
houyi_bow:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Minecraft mod 64×64 inventory weapon sprite, one standalone item.
Primary request: 后羿弓 (Houyi Bow), a legendary Chinese sun-archer's bow that is instantly identifiable as a bow.
Subject: a single tall reflex bow with distinctly separated upper and lower golden-brown wooden limbs, slightly recurved horn tips, taut light-gold bowstring visibly running between the two tips, wrapped cinnabar-red center grip, modest sun-ray engravings near the limb bases. The string must contrast against empty transparent space, and the overall silhouette must not resemble a ring or staff. No arrow.
Style/medium: polished hand-placed Minecraft pixel art, square hard-edged pixel clusters, readable at native 64×64, controlled 32–48 color palette, crisp 1–3 pixel highlights, no smooth gradients or airbrushing.
Composition: bow almost fills the square vertically, about 2 pixels margin, clean broad silhouette; visibly thick limbs and at least 2-pixel-equivalent string after downscaling.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent RGBA background, no floor, no inventory frame.
Constraints: one bow only; no text, watermark, labels, border, glow halo, extra objects or photorealistic rendering.
leiting_hammer:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Minecraft mod 64×64 inventory weapon sprite, one standalone item.
Primary request: 雷霆锤 (Thunder Hammer), an unmistakable heavy war hammer.
Subject: one broad double-faced rectangular dark gunmetal hammer head in the upper-right half, viewed three-quarter side-on, with clear cyan-blue angular lightning cracks and a simple bright lightning-bolt rune. Bronze-gold rim bands reinforce the head. A short stout dark-brown wrapped handle extends diagonally to lower-left with a gold pommel. Head should be substantially bigger than handle; sturdy T-shaped striking silhouette. Lightning must be engraved on head, not a floating effect.
Style/medium: polished hand-placed Minecraft pixel art, square hard-edged pixel clusters, readable at native 64×64, controlled 32–48 color palette, crisp 1–3 pixel highlights, no smooth gradients or airbrushing.
Composition: hammer nearly fills the square with about 2 pixels margin, all of striking head and handle visible; clean silhouette.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent RGBA background, no floor, no inventory frame.
Constraints: visually distinct from sword and bow; no text, watermark, labels, border, glow halo, extra objects, energy cloud, or photorealistic rendering.
